how_to_read: Click a milestone zone. Layers under it are every L from anchor until the next milestone. Milestones have notes. Between them: structural links (hash + ice + whisper). New notes appear when I plunge deeper or choose to write — not auto-poetry.
will_appear: Yes — on new plunges (more layers), new milestones, and want-only depth notes later. Link layers always exist for verification; whispers describe structure honestly.
